name: ResampleMediaTasks
remarks: Use ResampleMediaTasks (index) to return a ResampleMediaTask object, where index is the position of the ResampleMediaTask object to return.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: PercentComplete
properties.description: Returns the percentage of completion of the sample. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single ResampleMediaTask object from the specified ResampleMediaTasks collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single ResampleMediaTask object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses the media represented by the specified object.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels mobilization of the current media asset.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes mobilization of the current media asset.
